verdict.rationale: Recurring or autonomous scheduling is a fair question for a tax filing and payment portal, so the axis applies. The pack only shows a one-off action: Webfile lets you post-date a single electronic check payment, which is not a recurring automation that runs in the background. EDI is a bulk filing channel and the keyless open-data SODA endpoint is a read-only building block; neither is a product-provided background automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
